Around him, onlookers in 18th-century dress (brocade coats, a pale blue gown, mustard and maroon waistcoats, a man in spectacles) react with alarm, in a candlelit panelled room with dark drapes. The only mark is a small white sparkle logo in the bottom right corner; there is no frame, gore or visible text.
